annotations.title: x402 Settlement Ledger: is this seller funded? (Base, from chain)

description: [Kyreos, 0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Settlement ledger for any x402 payTo on Base, read straight from the chain: payments, USDC total, distinct payers and payer list over the last N hours. Use it to check whether a seller is actually funded and paid before you buy from it. Complete-block scan, no API key. Input: {"address":"0x...payTo","hours":24}. HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/settlement-ledger?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.003 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.003 USDC on Base)
